nom: Dior La Mousse OFF/ON Foaming Cleanser

avis.titre: Moisturizing, lotion-y, best used after a stronger cleanser
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way this makes my face feel after I use it, it makes my skin super soft. I don't think it's great as a cleanser on its own, my skin felt kind of greasy when I used it by itself. It does foam up but it's a very lotion-y foam that goes on thick. It's not terribly difficult to rinse off but it does leave a noticeable layer on the skin like how most lotions do. It did not make me break out at all, though my skin was a bit oilier than normal unless I used it after a stronger cleaner. It's nice as an extra step in a skincare routine for soft skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: Amazing product! Love using it it the morning and night to cleanse the skin. Doesn't strip the skin or make you face dry. It didn't break me out so that was a plus. There is no smell so that is good as well. I would recommend this product to people!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Over the past few months, this cleanser has become a consistent part of my skincare routine. The mousse texture creates a rich, creamy lather that feels luxurious without being overly heavy. It does an excellent job removing daily buildup, excess oil, and sunscreen while leaving my skin feeling clean, soft, and balanced. What I appreciate most is that it never leaves my skin feeling tight or stripped after rinsing. A little goes a long way, and the elegant scent adds to the overall experience. While it sits at a luxury price point, the performance and user experience feel worthy of the Dior name.

avis.titre: Fine cleanser to have for your routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Its ok. It give my skin a smooth finish and it also smell good. But sometimes, it makes my skin red. The bottle is pretty, packaging is good and easy to use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lovely thick cream face wash! Ingredients are not on the natural side and has a heavy fragrance if you are sensitive to smells. Very effective at cleaning the skin and does not dry out your face.It has an easy squeeze top to dispence just the right amount of product for glowing skin!

Smells amazing but seems a little too harsh for my aging skin. Im almost 40 and this cleanser seemed to dry me out a little more than what im used to. Very little is needed to get bright and clean results but not something I can use every day, maybe like twice per week max.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love love this luxury foaming facial cleanser. It leave the skin so clean and fresh. I was worried at first due to my skin being sensitive but this cleanser has been an amazing addition to my skin care, it also last a long time.

I'm just so happy to have anything that is Christian Dior because their products are so amazing. They smell so good. The texture is perfect and the hydration it leaves after using this product is beyond anything I can explain. This is a definite must have.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you didnt know, Dior means gold or golden, and this face cleaner is certainly that. It disppenses consistently, foams right up with a little water, wipes everything off almost seamlessly, leaves no residue, and leaves a clean and refreshed feeling face all night. I use it to clean my face after working in the shop, wife uses it after her workouts, and daughter uses it after school to clean off her makeup. All 3 of us love it. Leaves our faves feeling hydrated, clean, and protected. Overall, this product has been golden for face care in our house. Def recomend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For bringing luxury to the daily routine this foaming facial cleanser is everything you could ask for. Whether it is dirt, oil or any other product, this effectively removes anything in the way preventing breakouts. It has a rich texture with a subtle fragrance that feels high-end.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So luxurious! Works so great! So much value for the product. Lathers so well. I saw no breakout and my pore improved! I would heavily reccomend this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very lovely thick cream face wash! Ingredients are not 100% natural and has a heavy fragrance so if you are sensitive to smells its definitely heavily scented.Very effective at cleaning the skin and does not dry out your face.It has an easy squeeze top to dispence just the right amount of product for glowing skin!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure if I would like this product, but it's really growing on me. My skin feels clean after use, there's no irritation or discomfort, and it does as described.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] honestly, this cleanser was pretty good but not life changing. it worked pretty well and smells great, but i wouldn't say it's far above a lot of other luxury products on the market. i would say it's nice but not unique enough for me to purchase again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the way this cleanser foams up and it leaves my face feeling clean and not too dry. The scent is pleasant, it doesn't seem to irritate my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A must have in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this foaming face cleanser, it makes my face feel squeaky clean but still feeling moisturized. It's also a large bottle so it lasts a long time so it's a great value for the price!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product has a light fragrance and, when applied to the skin, creates just enough foam to remove excess sebum. It helps to remove some of my daily makeup. After using it, my skin doesn't feel dry or tight.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very thick rich feeling. Skin feels moisturized after using . Foams up good and lathers perfect. Has a nice pleasant smell. Also did not cause any breakouts at all. Fresh clear skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's ok for a cleanser. Smells a little strong and floral for me. It cleanses well but there are many more cheaper non-fragranced options I'd prefer.

avis.titre: Excellent cleanser that makes skin soft!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face cleaner leaves your skin soooo smooth! It's excellent for if you have a full face of makeup to remove or your skin is particularly oily. If you are sensitive to fragrances though, this might irritate you a little bit. The scent does linger for some time. One caveat for me was finding out that it is not non-comedogenic, so it clogs pores. I did have to make sure I exfoliated very well after waahing my face with it. But, I still recommended this right away! Fantastic cleanser.
Has horrible smell that doesn't wash off and also dries skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has a very pleasant aroma when using and does a good job cleansing skin gently. It does a good job on minimizing pores and has a nice texture. The size is excellent and using it twice a day I still have a lot of product left making it a great value.

avis.titre: An empty that'll always be refilled!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This has a lovely foaming lather as you wash your face. The fragrance is light and does not come off as strong but instead luxe. My skin feels hydrated and smooth after use! Love!

La Mousse OFF/ON Foaming Cleanser deeply cleanses the skin by removing residue, makeup, and sunscreen without leaving a heavy feeling. It's easy to apply and perfect for daily use—ideal if you're looking for a purifying yet gentle facial cleanser ✨🫧

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this product. If you are looking for elegant skin care this is it. Luxurious all white packaging with an expensive scent. It's light weight formula so it's perfect for any skin type. Your skin feels fresh and clean after use, and leaves a glow behind. I didn't experience any irritation even with the slight scent. Truly an incredible product for the girly looked for something a little extra!

avis.titre: I would buy this very creamy
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very thick rich feeling. Skin feels moisturized after using . Foams up good and lathers perfect. Has a nice pleasant smell. Also did not cause any breakouts at all. Fresh clear skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thick, very foamy but fragranced. This removes makeup well when lather properly, it is fragranced but it does not feel irritating. This cleanser leaves skin quite literally squeaky clean. It is, unfortunately, not hydrating. The bottle is quite heavy out of the box and has a simple hole applicator.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Excellent facial cleanser. Lathers up nicely to a very smooth texture. Easily removes make up, including my mascara. My skin feels very clean and hydrated after use. Does have a light fragrance.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved this cleanser the way it foamed up with very little product is great. I loved the scent very light and gentle on the skin. You know how some brands will have a big jar or bottle and then you notice that it's actually a small bowl and filled with plastic around it so you notice getting much product. This one you don't have to worry about that at all. Great product. Clean skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Pros: a little goes a long ways, it's cleansing but also hydrating, it's smooth like butter so it's fairly gentle on the skin Cons: I like the fragrance however a little more potent than I'd usually like to use in my face (I have rather sensitive skin Overall Dior did a great job on this mousse face wash, I would just cut down on the level of scent.
I truly love how creamy this face wash is! It is very fragrant but it's gentle on my sensitive skin.[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first thing I noticed was the intense scent. It is very strong, very designer. Applying it felt nice and not too stripping. Once washed off, it did feel a bit dry, but not horrible. I have very dry skin so it could be a factor. I like it, but don't love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a very soft and creamy cleanser and it indeed does leave your skin feeling hydrated. No feeling of dryness or rubber feeling after use . Used it for a week and didn't have any breakouts

I used this product only for a couple days. It made me break out bad but I do use sensitive skin. It smelt good and definitely was thick. It definitely cleaned my face when I was removing old makeup off my face it didn't take long for me to remove as the wash worked right away.
It feels so gentle on my skin, and the consistency is pretty thick—but I love that. When it's thick, it feels like it really works into my skin. It leaves my skin feeling squeaky clean.

avis.titre: i enjoyed this and it took all my makeup off
avis.texte: I liked this a lot better than expected, i always get scared cleansers are going to be drying but found this one worked perfect!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this cleanser alot! A little goes a long way, its foamy, and makes skin feel clean! For a general cleanser its good. I did not notice it do anything special except for cleaning my face. The scent is strong, but was expected so I wasn't surprised. Overall I would purchase it again.
This does as it says! I love the cleab feel afterwards and it does not leave my skin dry.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As much as I hate the price tag…this cleanser is great. I like the scent, though some people might find it overpowering. My skin feels super clean but moisturized when I wash my face! My only complaint is the packaging - I wish I didn't have to take off the cap every time!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A little goes a long way with this cream cleanser. I honestly didn't expect such a rich, luxurious lather from a cleanser, but this one delivers. The scent isn't subtle, it leans more mature and very luxe and my skin handled it well with no irritation. After cleansing, my skin felt clean yet comfortable, not stripped or tight. Elevated packaging, definitely giftable!

I did not enjoy the floral sent of this product. I ended up sharing this product with my grandma, and she loves it. She said it was very smooth, and left her face feeling "smooth like a baby's butt." I gave this product 3 stars because of her review and for the product's packaging - very luxe!

avis.titre: The scent on this is top tier
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] What I love most is how it leaves my skin feeling: clean but never tight, smooth but not squeaky. Just fresh, glowy, and like I actually take care of myself even on the days I'm exhausted. If you want something that feels gentle, smells amazing, and actually works, this is it. Dior snapped with this one.

avis.titre: I really do love this product
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very thick rich feeling. Skin feels moisturized after using . Foams up good and lathers perfect. Has a nice pleasant smell. Also did not cause any breakouts at all. Fresh clear skin

The scent is very light and fresh which is also a plus.

avis.titre: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I
avis.texte: this product is worth it, the quality is visible in just a few days

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I ADORE this formula. You only need a small amount to get the job done and it works really well. It's not drying either. I don't want my skin to feel zapped of moisture when I'm done washing it and this doesn't do that. It made my skin feel smooth and clean.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE!!! This cleanser is amazing. A little goes a long way. It feels like a lotion that foams up. Super easy to rinse and the smell is subtle. I like the shape of the bottom since it makes it easy to dispense a little at a time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] TLDR: it works as intended. Strips my face of any lotion, oil, dirt, etc. And it does a very good job at that. Simple and clean packaging and tube. Simple scent - fresh, sweet lemon, smells like a fancy hotel lobby in downtown Chitown. The scent lasts a long time too. Its a great product to use before putting on lotion or serum. I do wish the cap was a different design. Its awkward to put some product on my hand (that's holding the giant cap) and try to screw it back on. Not a huge deal. I may buy again, it is pricey but I think for 150mL it should last a long time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have dry skin during the winter and combination skin throughout the rest of the year, so I'm always cautious with facial cleansers. I really liked the Dior La Mousse facial wash — it feels luxurious and cleans my skin well without leaving it tight or uncomfortable. What stood out the most for me was how it didn't make my face feel overly dry, even in colder months when my skin is at its most sensitive. It lathers nicely, rinses clean, and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. While it's a bit of a splurge, the formula and experience make it worth trying, especially if you're looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Dior Off/On Mousse Face Wash is such a treat to use. The packaging is sleek and elegant, and it smells incredibly nice—luxurious and expensive. The texture is thick and moussey, and it feels amazing on the skin. After rinsing, my face feels soft, moisturized, and comfortable. It removes some makeup, but I like using it after a cleansing balm. A beautiful addition to my routine

avis.titre: Highly recommend if you want spa like treatment!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser smells absolutely amazing and instantly elevates my skincare routine. The foam feels so soft and luxurious on the skin—it honestly felt like I was at a spa getting a professional facial. My face felt clean, refreshed, and pampered after every use. A truly indulgent experience."

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to receive this product to test as I originally was sent the first face wash version of this item. I really enjoyed that product, so I was intrigued to see what the difference would be with this one. This product is super thick so a small amount of the product goes such a long way, so you do get a good value for the price of this product! I love the way it goes on the skin - it feels really luxurious as it foams up while rubbing it on the face and feels very hydrating, not stripping, on the skin; I do want to mention it is also very light which I enjoy. I also want to note that it does have quite a strong floral scent, but I enjoy it quite a lot and it doesn't linger on the skin after washing the product off. I'm okay with facial products being scented as long as they're wash off items. I've been reaching for this every day and it leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and not irritated which I was worried it would due to the strong scent. I've really enjoyed this product so far and will most likely buy it again. Overall, I'd recommend this product if you're in the market to try a new face wash that leaves your skin feeling smooth and soothed and also has a lovely scent!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was a really nice cream cleanser. I like the packaging and the texture of the wash. The only thing I didn't like is the strong fragrance. Other than that this was a really nice cleanser that is gentle and hydrating. Even with the fragrance it didn't irritate my skin after a chemical peel.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved the cleanser and definitely noticed how hydrated my face feels after I use it. It has a nice but somewhat manly smell. I even had to double check if the cleanser claimed to have male audience. But after some time I got used to the smell and didn't notice it. The cleanser smells luxurious

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this face wash! It removes makeup very well and keeps my face feeling so clean without a repeated wash like I have to do with some other face washes. It does have a strong scent but I don't mind it.

avis.titre: Face Fragrance, May also Clean a Clean Face.

The fragrance is so overwhelming, it clings to your face, it clung to my face cloth and my pillow case for days. It didn't clean my makeup off well enough to use this as a substitute for my normal items and I got a little bit into my eye and it burned with the might of a thousand suns. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the scent of this cleanser although it is pretty strong and it lingers for quite a while so if your skin is sensitive to fragrance this might not be for you. It doesn't leave any residue but it does make your face feel squeaky clean with that slight tight feeling but nothing that a little moisturizer can't fix. I do really like it and will continue to use it.

avis.titre: Pretty good, just smells a lot
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My first impression of the product was the incredible amount of fragrance coming from the product. When I put it on my face the first time, I felt like I'd sprayed perfume on my face. After a few uses however I've gotten a bit used to the scent, which admittedly is nice. The cleanser removed my makeup well, left my face feeling squeaky clean but not tight, and didn't irritate my extremely sensitive skin. I will continue to use it on stubborn makeup days, but probably not all the time. I do recommend it if you like fragranced product. If you don't like fragrance, skip it.

avis.titre: Is this a new holy grail?

Not something I think I would've purchased solely based on price but now that I've been given the chance to try it, I'll definitely be ordering another when this one is done. This is a very luxurious cleanser. From the texture to the ease of use. Washing my face now after work feels like an experience. Very "spa-like" to me. I know there's other alternatives that are less pricey but this is luxury and it truly feels like it. Very large bottle so I see getting atleast 60+ days out of this and the breakdown on price is more reasonable when I look at it that way.

This is the richest softest cream and the cleanest my skin has ever felt. This makes me want to wash my face over and over. I've never had more flawless skin. You can feel this product cleansing your skin as you wash away all the impurities. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 🌿✨

It does leave your skin squeaky clean, so definitely follow the directions and avoid the eye area because it can dry that part out. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the packaging, definitely gives Dior vibes, with it nice, clean, and sleek look. This foaming cleanser from Christian Dior is a staple in my routine. I love the scent and foaming sensation, it gets off all my makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft and supple. It also keeps hydration in and makes my skin glow! I love how Dior has come out with skin care products, I'll continue adding more into my routine!

So excited to try this, but disappointed but the heavy scent (although, it does smell nice, I just prefer skincare without fragrance). My skin does tend to be on the drier side & I did feel it left my skin feeling tight and dry.

I'm not the biggest fan of using branded facial cleansers, but since this was a gift, I wanted to try it. My face felt super hydrated and smooth. I can see why it's expensive but super worth the price

I look glowy-er and my skin is so clear! I am 38 with combo skin. Warning it does have a strong scent - Dior beauty products always do!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Washes my skin without leaving my skin dry and tight. Removes makeup thoroughly and is easy to use. I think it is hydrating and a good staple face wash.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The smell of it is really nice, its not harsh on my sensitive skin and my skin feels smooth afterwards and so clean. A little bit goes a long way with it, so when I go to reorder it will be awhile from now.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's amazing for sensitive skin and it makes my skin so smooth and shiny and well cleansed. It also feels like there's not much chemicals on there and it's amazing for a baby soft skin!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Smells heavenly. Goes on smoothly like butter. A small amount is all that is needed to lather up greatly. Takes makeup off pretty well. Love this cleanser! Doesn't leave your skin feeling dry afterwards.

avis.titre: Leaves the skin feeling clean and fresh
avis.texte: My skin is typically sensitive, but I didn't have any issues using this product. It left my skin feeling clean and fresh and no residue. I have combination skin and the T zone gets very oily, but this did not cause it to feel oily.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Luxurious packaging. The formula is creamy and has a strong fragrance which is on brand for Dior skincare. The Dior La Mousse Off/On Foaming Cleanser has the best consistency. It is a soft mousse foam that lathers abundantly. It does an excellent job at removing makeup and debris. It does not irritate the skin.

avis.titre: Floral creamy cleanser for oily skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy this cleanser. It does have a fragrance but I think it's pleasant and adds to the experience while using it. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice cleanser that doesn't dry out skin too much and feels gentle. It has a subtle foaming texture when lathered. It didn't irritate my sometimes sensitive skin, even though it has a pleasant, light scent. Washes off cleanly.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE!!! This cleanser is amazing. A little goes a long way. It feels like a lotion that foams up. Super easy to rinse and the smell is subtle. I like the shape of the bottom since it makes it easy to dispense a little at a time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Dior foaming purifying and hydrating facial cleanser gets nice and foamy and makes my skin smooth. It hasn't given me any breakouts or irritation and is good for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Thick, rich formula, soft shine left behind
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been consistently using this for a few weeks to get a genuine impression before sharing how it"s going. Overall, am quite impressed. Packaging is durable, secure, and beautiful in its simplicity. The mousse is thick, rich, lathers into a sudsy foam fantastically, and a little goes a long way. Always great news for desired amount of time a whole product lasts. It has a clean scent that reminds me of a fresh, soft, simple ivory soap. I can safely report this Dior cleanser has treated my skin barrier well, even with niacinamide included. My take away is that it gently, effectively cleanses away makeup (easily including my impossible waterproof mascara), dirt and sweat buildup, leaving behind a softer texture that I can see a squeaky clean shine of hydration from. It does not leave my naturally leaning toward the dry end skin tight and dry, but I can feel that it's perfectly ready for a good moisturizer followup. Importantly, it has not irritated my face with bumps, redness, itching, or dry patches. My understanding of being titled OFF/ON is it cleans off makeup, impurities, microparticles and pollutants while leaving on healthy hydration, a stronger, well soothed skin barrier. It makesmperfect sense after using it. Enjoyable experience here.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved the face wash. It was sort of a salve/lotion feeling on application. It really got into my pores and I only needed one wash even with heavy makeup which was great. It takes more effort to rinse, but once it does it leaves my skin plush.

avis.titre: I received this product in exchange for my honest review
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Christian Dior's La Mousse OFF/ON is a highly recommended luxury cleanser that justifies the investment with exceptional longevity (a single tube can last 4 to 6 months, as a little goes a long way). Its performance stands out for creating a rich foam that effectively removes impurities and pollution ('OFF') without drying out the skin, resulting in a soft, soothed, and luminous complexion thanks to its protective action ('ON'). It is particularly suitable for combination and sensitive skin types seeking a deep yet gentle cleanse, combining an elegant sensory experience with superior technical efficacy

I wear minimal makeup so can't say if it does a deep cleaning but it did get off the little i do wear pretty easily. This didn't make me break out at all, but i will say i didn't notice much of a difference in my face from my other moisturizer. A little bit goes a long way so this will probably last awhile. Definitely loved this product
Girlfriend has been using this foaming cleaner and has found it super useful. Feels really great on her skin, makes the face feel really clean, and is easy to use
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great facewash

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Dior La Mousse OFF/ON Foaming Cleanser daily and I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is incredibly luxurious—it transforms into a rich, airy foam that feels soft and comforting on the skin.
